nodes.text: India’s first few cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) were confirmed in Karnataka, Gujarat, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu, involving at least seven children. The Union Health Ministry reassures that the virus, first identified in 2001, is not new and infections are manageable. https://t.co/9InbsYOcUY

nodes.author: agnel_cjk
nodes.text:
@karnatakaportf "India’s first few cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV)"

Wrong. This is not a new virus. These are not the "first few cases"
